items.title: Daniel Jones has cleared waivers and is now free to sign with any team.
Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) did not practice on Monday.
items.text: It was an estimated session. Mitchell talked with reporters after leaving Sunday’s game with the hamstring ailment, implying it wasn’t a super serious injury. Still, on a short week, his status is up in the air. If he were ruled out, it would only help CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens on Thanksgiving. - Rivers McCown

items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is practicing in full ahead of Philadelphia’s Thursday game against the Cowboys.
items.text: We’re expecting the Eagles to force-feed Smith once more after his 57 percent target share on Sunday, leaving him as a plausible WR2 in an elevated matchup against the Cowboys defense. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Will Shipley (foot/illness) was limited in Monday’s practice.
items.text: It was an estimated session and exactly the same listing he had on Friday. As he was practicing on a limited basis before the illness (and before being activated off injured reserve last Saturday), we’ll assume he has a fairly good chance to suit up on Thursday. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Dallas Goedert (shin) was limited in Monday’s practice.
items.text: It’s a new (estimated) listing after his one-catch outing against the Steelers. Goedert was at least set up with a Joe Milton #RevengeGame script against a weak Cowboys defense this week to try to rebound, but it will be hard to rely on him as a streamer TE1 if healthy. We’ll see if he can get to the second part of that statement tomorrow. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Saquon Barkley (neck/illness) was limited in Monday’s practice.
items.text: We described Barkley as leaving the game in the fourth quarter with what “appeared to be a left arm” injury in Sunday’s blurb, it sounds like it may have been a stinger based on the neck listing. A limited (estimated) session is better than a DNP, but Tuesday’s report will loom large for Barkley’s chances of playing against the Cowboys on Thursday. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) was limited in Monday’s practice.
items.text: Parsons has been limited in each of the Packers’ first two practices to start the week. It’s long been believed that the star pass-rusher could be activated for Wednesday’s game against the Rams, but the team has declined to say whether or not that will come to fruition. We will likely have an official word on Parsons’ Week 12 availability when the Packers release their final injury report on Tuesday. - Zachary Krueger

items.title: Colby Parkinson (ribs) practiced in full on Monday.
items.text: He’s gotten in two full sessions coming off the bye and figures to remain one of the main figures in the Rams’ floating opera of tight end production that they’ll likely be relying on this week sans Puka Nacua and Davante Adams. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Josh Jacobs (thumb) was limited in Monday’s practice.
items.text: Jacobs has been limited in each of the Packers’ first two practices as they prepare to face the Rams on Wednesday. While a limited session would generally be viewed as an encouraging sign for a player, head coach Matt LaFleur said earlier that he doesn’t expect Jacobs to suit up this week. We will continue to track his status until he receives an official designation for the game, but we’re assuming based on LaFleur’s comments that Jacobs will miss at least one more week. - Zachary Krueger

items.title: Kyren Williams (toe) practiced in full on Monday.
items.text: It’s an upgrade from a limited session on Sunday and we’d be surprised if Williams was placed on the questionable line on Tuesday. - Rivers McCown
